ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dup_check IS
 check_dup number;
 temp number;

BEGIN
 
/* Check from database */
select count(*) into temp from valid_profile_tests where
 test_id=:valid_profile_tests.test_id;

if temp > 0 then
 message('Duplicate Test ID');pause;
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end if;

/* check from buffer */

 
 if nvl(:global.test_id,' ') != nvl(:valid_profile_tests.test_id,' ') then
 
 check_insert_rg('test_rg0','C10',:global.test_id||',','D',check_dup); 
 
 end if;

 check_insert_rg('test_rg0','C10',:valid_profile_tests.test_id||',','C',check_dup);
 
 if check_dup = 1 then
 message('Duplicate Test ID'); pause;
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 else
 check_insert_rg('test_rg0','C10',:valid_profile_tests.test_id||',','U',check_dup); 
 
 end if;

END;
